title: parosela vulneraria
intro: Parosela vulneraria, commonly known as Indian gentian, is a plant species that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in various folk remedies to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Parosela vulneraria include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, while its therapeutic actions may include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents present in Parosela vulneraria include gentiopicrin, gentianine, and amarogentin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
